changes.reason: WP7: D33e: the cited Fabindia SBI Card T&C (11.4 Points) state only "5 Reward Points per Rs100 spent at Fabindia" and "Added Reward Points on Dining, Entertainment, International spends and more"; they give no rate for other spends. The record contradicts itself: its accrual base is 1 Reward Point per Rs200, while this rule says 1 per Rs100 (and its "2x" international rule is also 1 per Rs100). Unknown rate, so info (H2): the card base of 1 per Rs200 governs and can only under-state.
